description: GLV-Connect Enterprise Error Memory — permanent record of resolved bugs, root causes, and prevention rules. CI reads this file to validate that all prevention patterns are in place before merge.

errors.name: Cross-document state contamination (Nigeria → Turkey)
errors.root_cause: setView('new-sco') while already on 'new-sco' is a React no-op — useEffect never fires, newDocKey not incremented, CommercialEngine not remounted. Stale Turkey state saved to Nigeria document.
errors.resolution: Replaced useEffect with safeSetView() that unconditionally increments newDocKey before any new-* navigation. CountrySearch input synced via useEffect on value prop.
errors.validation_rule: App.jsx must contain safeSetView function that increments newDocKey before setting new-* views.

errors.name: PDF Price Contamination (PRICE_TABLE override)
errors.root_cause: pricePerKg in GlvPDF.jsx had fallback: engineUnitPrice || parseFloat(doc.pricePerKg). doc.pricePerKg is written at save time from PRICE_TABLE lookup (e.g. UAE = 5.70), overriding the user-entered price (e.g. 3.50).
errors.resolution: pricePerKg = engineUnitPrice || null — no PRICE_TABLE fallback. CommercialEngine incotermPrices is the sole source.
errors.validation_rule: GlvPDF.jsx must never assign pricePerKg using doc.pricePerKg as a fallback.

errors.name: Category Formula Contamination (LIVE_ANIMALS formula leaking)
errors.root_cause: GlvPDF.jsx used engineHeads = firstCdRow.quantity for ALL categories, and engineAvgW defaulted to 45. For FROZEN_MEAT with quantity=25000: 25000 × 45 = 1,125,000 kg — wrong by factor of 45.
errors.resolution: Added isLiveAnimalRow guard. LIVE_ANIMALS: totalKg = heads × avgWeight. All other categories: totalKg = direct quantity. engineHeads and engineAvgW are zero for non-livestock rows.
errors.validation_rule: GlvPDF.jsx must contain isLiveAnimalRow category isolation guard.

errors.name: Media proxy authentication (401 on PDF image fetch)
errors.root_cause: fetchAsBase64 in mediaAutoBinding.js called /media/proxy without Authorization header. Proxy is behind authenticate() middleware. Returns 401 silently, images fail to load.
errors.resolution: Added getAuthHeader() reading glv_token from localStorage, injected into all fetch calls to /media/proxy.
errors.validation_rule: mediaAutoBinding.js must include JWT auth header in all proxy requests.

errors.name: Category resolution snake_case/camelCase mismatch
errors.root_cause: mediaAutoBinding.js read doc.product_category but API returns doc.productCategory (camelCase). category was always null → wrong media category sent to /media/bind.
errors.resolution: Category resolution reads both: doc.productCategory || doc.product_category || firstRow?.category.
errors.validation_rule: mediaAutoBinding.js must check both camelCase and snake_case for category resolution.

errors.name: AVOCAVIVA/fruit branding appearing in LIVE_ANIMALS SCO
errors.root_cause: Branding asset scoring had no category awareness. AVOCAVIVA logo scored high on 'brand' keywords and appeared in livestock documents.
errors.resolution: Added BRANDING_EXCLUSION_KEYWORDS per category and isBrandingCompatible() filter. Branding assets with product-specific keywords incompatible with document category are excluded.
errors.validation_rule: mediaBinding.js must contain isBrandingCompatible() category filter.

errors.name: FRUIT_PRODUCTS SCO renders sheep/livestock images
errors.root_cause: mediaBinding.js only filtered branding assets by category, but product (non-branding) assets had no category compatibility check. Sheep images tagged with 'livestock' could score into FRUIT_PRODUCTS documents.
errors.resolution: Added PRODUCT_CATEGORY_EXCLUSIONS and isProductCategoryCompatible() hard filter applied to all product assets before scoring. FRUIT_PRODUCTS cannot load LIVE_ANIMALS assets.
errors.validation_rule: mediaBinding.js must contain isProductCategoryCompatible() for non-branding product assets.

errors.name: Agent profile validation loop (cargo blocks SCO/FCO forever)
errors.root_cause: validateDocForm checked agentProfile.cargo which is SUPER ADMIN managed. If SUPER ADMIN never set cargo, agent is permanently blocked. Also: completed=1 flag in backend required cargo+phone+country+signature — agents could never self-complete.
errors.resolution: 1) validateDoc: short-circuit on agentProfile.completed===1 (never re-ask if profile complete). Cargo removed from requirements. 2) Backend completed flag: requires only phone + signature_b64. 3) NewDocForm refreshes agentProfile on mount. 4) Profile banner warns user when incomplete.
errors.validation_rule: validateDoc.js must short-circuit profile checks when agentProfile.completed === 1.

errors.name: Destination port contamination (stale portInfo from doc.destination fallback)
errors.root_cause: PDF used findPortInfo(doc.destination) as fallback when commercialData.destinationPort was empty. If doc.destination was stale, wrong port appeared.
errors.resolution: Port display priority: commercialData.destinationPort > portInfo.port > doc.destination. commercialData is always authoritative.
errors.validation_rule: GlvPDF.jsx must prioritize commercialData.destinationPort over doc-level port fields.

prevention_ci_manifest.description: All patterns below are verified by the CI formula-isolation-check job before merge.
